review_candidates.title: Mid-Level Mainframe Infrastructure Engineer – CICS Systems Programmer
review_candidates.description: Why USAA? At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families. Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful. We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs. The Opportunity R0120610 Mid-Level Mainframe Infrastructure Engineer – CICS Systems Programmer USAA Mainframe Infrastructure team is looking for Mainframe Infrastructure Engineer who under direct supervision will work on the installation, configuration, maintenance, and tuning of IBM's Customer Information Control System (CICS) on mainframe z/OS operating systems. At USAA, CICS is a mission critical application crucial for managing high-volume, online transaction processing. As a dedicated Mid-Level Mainframe Infrastructure Engineer – CICS Systems Programmer, you will directly contribute to enabling USAA’s Mission in delivering technology solutions for our members through effective administration of Customer Information Control System (CICS) on the Mainframe. The Individual contributor will be responsible for understanding, maintaining, managing, and troubleshooting CICS system and application issues for the overall CICS environment which is a complex CICS environment with over 700 CICS regions to support. The individual contributor will be instrumental in the ongoing efficacy of customer-facing applications that rely on CICS environment usage and access. The Individual will continue to protect USAA’s members and brand through the execution of effective risk processes and related controls, and maximize operational efficiencies. The individual will share on-call, upgrades, updates, migrations, patching, working with team. The individual contributor will also help support expectations and requirements from the various lines of businesses and will work to diagnose and troubleshoot problems. This role requires an understanding of mainframe technologies. Proficiency in programming languages like JCL and REXX, along with experience in mainframe tools and utilities, is essential. The work environment is typically dynamic and may require after-hours or on-call support to maintain the availability of mission-critical applications. We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX or Plano, TX. Relocation assistance is NOT available for this position. What You'll Do System Installation and Maintenance: Installing, configuring, upgrading, and maintaining CICS Transaction Server and related software. This involves applying vendor patches, fixes, and new product releases, often using tools like SMP/E. Performance and Capacity Management: Monitoring CICS system performance, identifying bottlenecks, and tuning CICS regions to meet service level agreements (SLAs). This may involve analyzing performance data using tools such as Intellimagic, RMF and BMC Mainview. Problem Resolution: Troubleshooting and debugging complex system and application issues, which can include analyzing system dumps and collaborating with application developers and software vendors for solutions. Developer Support: Providing technical support to application development teams, which includes setting up and managing CICS regions and defining necessary application resources. System Integration: Working with other z/OS systems programmers to integrate CICS with other mainframe subsystems, such as DB2 (database management) and MQ (messaging). Security and Disaster Recovery: Implementing and maintaining CICS security protocols (e.g., using RACF) and assisting in the planning, testing, and execution of disaster recovery procedures. Automation: Developing and implementing automation scripts (e.g., using REXX) to streamline system management and improve efficiency. Under limited supervision, designing scalable IT system infrastructure, implements system changes with consistency and autonomy, and automates service delivery and maintenance tasks; builds monitoring and tooling for systems. Independently, resolving complex technology production issues by troubleshooting IT systems. Identifying opportunities for improvements and makes recommendations to management. Analyzing complex outages and identifying opportunities for system improvements. Understand the customer and identifying solutions and ideas. Evaluating potential Technology solutions with some oversight. Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures. What You Have Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience. 4 years of infrastructure experience demonstrating depth of technical understanding to include an understanding of mainframe infrastructure and z/OS. Proficient level of business acumen in the areas of scripting and programming languages such as JCL, REXX and other mainframe scripting languages. Proficient level of business acumen in the areas of business operations, risk management, industry practices and emerging trends. Knowledge and understanding of designing scalable IT system infrastructures, implementing system changes, or automating service delivery and maintenance tasks. What Sets You Apart Installation and Maintenance Proficiency: Strong expertise in mainframe product installation, configuration, and maintenance, often including Independent Software Vendor (ISV) installations and upgrades. SMP/E Proficiency: Experience with SMP/E (System Modification Program/Extended) for installing and maintaining software. z/OS Expertise: In-depth knowledge of z/OS operating systems, including configuration, maintenance, and tuning. z/OS Subsystems: Understanding of other z/OS subsystems such as DB2, MQ, JES2, z/OS connect, IMS and TCP/IP. Performance Tuning and Monitoring: Experience with performance tuning and the use of monitoring tools (e.g., RMF, Intellimagic, BMC Mainview). Familiarity with Assembler, and PL/I is also beneficial. Security: Experience with security, often using RACF or equivalent tools. Automation and Scheduling: Familiarity with automation tools, job scheduling, and monitoring tools. Disaster Recovery: Experience with disaster recovery planning and testing. Mainframe Hardware: Understanding of mainframe hardware and architecture to optimize system performance. US military experience gained through military service or gained as a military spouse / domestic partner. Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $93,770 - $179,240 . USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.). Compensation: USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location. Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors. The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job. Benefits: At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals. For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com. Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting. USAA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

review_candidates.title: Field IT Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description: The Role The IT Operations Engineer is a mid-level technical role responsible for independently supporting, troubleshooting, installing, and maintaining end-user technology and core IT infrastructure across multiple business locations. This position builds upon the foundational responsibilities of the Associate IT Operations Engineer by taking greater ownership of assigned systems, resolving more complex incidents, and completing infrastructure work with limited supervision. The IT Operations Engineer serves as a reliable escalation resource for routine and moderately complex technical issues, contributes to projects and system improvements, and helps developing team members follow established standards. This role is expected to travel up to 40% to support company sites and participate in after-hours, weekend, and holiday on-call rotations. This is a remote role that requires up to 40% travel. Responsibilities End-User Hardware and Application Support Independently troubleshoot, install, configure, repair, and maintain PCs, laptops, retail Point of Sale (PoS) systems, registers, receipt and label printers, iPads/iOS devices, VoIP phones, and related end-user technologies. Diagnose hardware, software, peripheral, account, and connectivity issues; implement solutions and document work performed. Coordinate equipment deployments, replacements, moves, and lifecycle activities while minimizing disruption to business operations. Technology Infrastructure Support Support and maintain Dell and Nutanix server environments, Windows Server 2016/2019, Meraki and Fortinet switches, firewalls, wireless access points, manufacturing IoT devices, ISP circuits, and related infrastructure. Perform standard configuration changes, software installations, firmware updates, patching, testing, and preventive maintenance under established change-management procedures. Troubleshoot copper Ethernet and single-mode fiber connectivity, network performance, wireless coverage, and site interconnectivity issues. Take primary support ownership for assigned systems or locations while escalating high-risk, highly complex, or architecture-level issues to Senior Engineers or management. Incident and Service Management Monitor, prioritize, investigate, and resolve incidents and service requests through the Freshservice helpdesk platform. Proactively and reactively respond to alerts generated by the SolarWinds monitoring platform and other operational tools. Act as an escalation resource for Associate Engineers on routine and moderately complex incidents. Coordinate technical response activities during assigned incidents, communicate status to stakeholders, and engage Senior Engineers or vendors when broader leadership or advanced expertise is required. Contribute technical findings to root-cause reviews and implement approved corrective or preventive actions. Project and Site Support Complete assigned portions of infrastructure upgrades, site openings, remodels, equipment refreshes, and technology deployments. Review project requirements, identify technical dependencies, provide status updates, and communicate risks or delays to project leads. Work effectively at offices, retail locations, manufacturing facilities, warehouses, and active construction sites, including environments that may be hot, cold, dusty, or temporarily without normal facilities. Travel as required, including occasional last-minute trips, to support business-critical issues and scheduled project work. Documentation, Standards, and Team Development Create and maintain accurate technical documentation, installation records, support procedures, diagrams, asset information, and knowledge-base articles. Follow and reinforce company standards for security, change control, incident management, equipment installation, and customer communication. Provide practical guidance and knowledge sharing to Associate Engineers without serving as the team’s primary mentor, technical authority, or highest escalation point. Identify recurring issues and recommend practical improvements to system reliability, support processes, and operational efficiency. On-Call And Other Duties Participate in after-hours, weekend, and holiday on-call support rotations. Support information systems planning, implementation, administration, and operational readiness across multiple IT functional areas. Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management. Qualifications / Requirements High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a related field preferred. Flexibility to participate in on-call rotations and travel up to 40%, including occasional last-minute travel. 3+ years of progressively responsible experience in IT operations, infrastructure support, field services, systems administration, or a related technical role. Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve moderately complex hardware, software, server, network, wireless, and connectivity issues. Working knowledge of end-user devices, retail PoS technology, Windows environments, server infrastructure, network equipment, monitoring platforms, and IT service-management practices. Experience performing installations, configuration changes, patching, equipment deployments, and preventive maintenance using documented procedures. Ability to organize work, manage multiple priorities, communicate status, and complete assignments with limited day-to-day supervision. Strong written and verbal communication skills and a professional approach when working with internal customers, vendors, contractors, and team members. Ability to document technical work clearly and provide appropriate guidance to less-experienced team members. Ability to pass state cannabis licensing requirements, including federal background checks. Valid driver’s license and ability to meet company travel requirements, where applicable. Physical And Work Environment Requirements Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and perform equipment setup, boxing, unboxing, mounting, and cable installation. Ability to walk, stand, bend, kneel, climb stairs and ladders, use basic hand tools, take accurate measurements, and perform minor installation or carpentry-related tasks when required.
